UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile, favorites, watch history, and religious preferences

email.description: The user's Google or Apple account email

myList.description: JSON array of saved favorite video IDs

history.description: JSON array of watched video history items

notes.description: JSON array of personal spiritual notes and reflections

preferences.description: JSON serialized user preferences (location, notifications, theme, adhan preference)

VideoSuggestion.title: VideoSuggestion
VideoSuggestion.description: Community user video suggestions with upvote counter

url.description: URL of the video (YouTube, MP4, Vimeo, Dailymotion)

voteCount.description: Total number of people who requested/voted for this video

voters.description: Array of user IDs or voter fingerprints

status.description: Status of suggestion: pending, approved, published

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of last vote or edit

CreatorMessage.title: CreatorMessage
CreatorMessage.description: Direct messages sent by community users to the creator

subject.description: Subject or topic of the message

category.description: Message category: feedback, question, idea, thanks, technical

videoContext.description: Optional video title or ID related to the message

status.description: Status of the message: unread, read, archived

/users/{userId}.description: Document holding user specific preferences, saved list, notes, and history

/video_suggestions/{suggestionId}.description: Community video suggestions for admin moderation and import

/creator_messages/{messageId}.description: Messages sent by users to the content creator

/creator_content/{contentId}.description: Published creator videos and catalog items
